findings.original: Literal equality of F(A[a,b]) and F(A)[a,b] for arbitrary exact F.
findings.correction: Equality of their isomorphism closures, using the given shift comparison of the exact functor.
findings.adverse_evidence: The constant exact functor to a contractible two-term complex Q has images Q and Q[-1], distinct objects of D(Ab). All subsequent receiving C_n categories are strictly full.
findings.scope: A literal object-set precision correction; no failure of the subsequent generator applications is claimed.

findings.original: The proof bounds H^i(X,K), then uses the bound for RΓ(X,K tensor^L E); the next proof repeats H^i(X,F) in its arbitrary-window assertion.
findings.correction: Use H^i(X,K tensor^L E) and H^i(X,F tensor E), keeping the fixed finite locally free E and the original final dimension bound.
